# OrrePort

> Pokémon Colosseum (USA, GC6E01) decompiled to C and running natively on PC, with a modding suite. Code only: no game data.

## Read first

- README.md: what OrrePort is, download, building
- CONTRIBUTING.md: how to contribute, the rules every change meets
- docs/design-guide.md: what the project decides itself
- docs/building.md: building from source, step by step

## Players

- docs/saves.md: .gci and .orresave saves, the GameCube copy
- docs/accurate-mode.md: GameCube-accurate mode
- docs/controls-and-settings.md: every control and setting
- docs/debug-menu.md: the debug menu

## Modders, translators and tool makers

- docs/hook-points.md: where changes plug into the game code
- docs/translation.md: the language files and how to add a language
- docs/orresave-format.md: the .orresave format
- docs/function_renames.csv, docs/data_renames.csv: the rename map (old name, new name, address); tools/apply_rename_map.py applies it

## Other port and decompilation projects

- docs/for-other-projects.md: what's reusable and how it was built
- docs/testing-method.md: how recordings and replays prove the port matches the game

## Code

- src/, include/: the game's decompiled code (src/game is Genius Sonority's game code; src/hsd the HSD library; src/musyx audio; src/dolphin the SDK)
- port/: the PC layer (Aurora, hook points, the hub)
- studio/: OrrePort Studio, the editor
- tools/: build, test and disc-reading tools

## How the engine works

- https://github.com/snatcherLeo/orre-engine-docs
